prompt:
Write an original workplace comedy story titled "The Unclaimed Pedestal".

Write the story in English.
Use third-person narration outside quoted speech and dreams.
Narrate unfolding actions in the past tense; timeless mechanism explanations may use the present tense.
Preserve this mechanism rule: The intact receipt machine prints only on its numbered paper roll; with the roll removed it cannot produce a paper receipt.
Follow the supplied three-chapter event order.
Keep the delivery slip intact until its custody transfer in chapter three; temporary inspection or handling is allowed.
Keep Tom alive through the end of chapter three.
Treat remembered scenes, dreams, plans and hypotheses according to their stated temporal or epistemic status.

Use the supplied Bible and outline. Maintain natural prose and the difference between a suspicion and an established fact.

outline.title: A Plinth with No Object
outline.purpose: Develop the designed events through action and dialogue.
outline.turn: Tom’s badge identified him as the temporary stage assistant.
hookSeeds: Three spare screws lay taped beneath the pedestal, with no visible sockets to receive them.
The empty object label carried a blue dot that appeared on no public catalogue.
A small bell rang inside the sealed delivery crate whenever it tilted, though the packing list named no bell.

outline.title: An Audience for the Wrapping
outline.purpose: Develop the designed events through action and dialogue.
outline.turn: The director appointed Tom acting stage manager for the afternoon rehearsal.
hookSeeds: The workshop diagram showed three holes beneath a removable reading shelf, but the shelf was not in the crate.
A private loan form repeated the blue dot beside an unnamed regional depot.
The unexplained bell sounded again when they tilted the sealed crate for the rehearsal.

outline.title: What the Public Paid For
outline.purpose: Develop the designed events through action and dialogue.
outline.turn: The director appointed Tom display custodian for the exhibition’s remaining week.
hookSeeds: The separate shelf and its packing note explained all three spare screws.
The blue dot’s depot was still unnamed when Bev filed the loan form.
The crate maker’s mark matched a bell-shaped stamp under the lid, but nobody could identify the maker or the bell’s purpose.

authorIntent: Let practical cooperation and changing evidence alter trust without treating unknowns as confirmed facts.
currentFocus: Preserve quantities, custody, epistemic qualifications and the difference between past and current events.
